notes: Replaces the item-sheet reload widget with an automatic floating Weapon Tracker HUD.

Each completed canonical firearm attack increments that actor's tracked attacks-used count for the fired weapon and opens the HUD with weapon image, manufacturer, class, attacks remaining, attacks fired, and physical magazine/capacity context.
Reload progress remains player-confirmed: Action adds 2 points and Bonus Action adds 1 point; reaching the weapon's reload-point requirement automatically resets its attacks-used counter.
The tracker never spends actions, blocks an attack, or mutates real ammunition. It includes Undo Shot and Reset Tracker controls for table corrections.
game.adk.weaponTracker.open() manually opens the tracker for the selected actor or user character's first equipped canonical firearm. game.adk.reloadTracker remains a compatibility alias.
Firearm item cards now explain the automatic shot counter and manual reload-progress model.
